manualReviewNotes: All imageUrls are Google Shopping search intent URLs. Need SearchAPI replacement before catalog integration.
Multiple items exceed $3,000 — Sylistly may need a 'luxury' budget tier to properly classify these (Bottega $3,800, Loewe $2,700, Loro Piana $4,800, Cartier $6,750, Dior $5,200).
Common Projects Achilles at $490 is the best value in this pack — high quality score for its price.
Rick Owens, Amiri, and Off-White serve the edgy/streetwear premium builds — distinct from old-money items.
Acne Studios camel coat ($1,200) and Loro Piana ($4,800) are both camel coats at very different price points — good range.
This pack is intentionally aspirational — these items make the app feel credible to fashion-forward users even if rarely purchased.
